sentences.text:
The present application has been filed with the prayer to grant anticipatory bail to the applicant in Case Crime No.206 of 2024, under sections 498A, 354Ka, 323, 506 I.P.C. and 3/4 D.P. Act, P.S.
Simbhawali, District Hapur.
At the outset, Sri Ashwini Kumar Srivastava, counsel for the applicant prays for withdrawal of the instant application.
Accordingly, the application is dismissed as withdrawn.
Sri Rishi Chaddha, learned AGA for the State is present.
